Coverage_Description: Two options: K12 (2 annual scaling/cleaning visits) or K21 (1 annual scaling/cleaning visit), plus oral exam, needed intraoral X-rays/fluoride, caries-related fillings, simple extr; excludes specialist care, deep scaling, major imaging, wisdom/surgical/orthodontic extractions, and non-caries/cosmetic fillings
pricing: HK$575/year (Plan K12, 2 cleanings); HK$470/year (Plan K21, 1 cleaning).
customer requirement: For eligible HKFLU affiliated member-union members and their family (parents, spouse, children, siblings); family enrollment requires the member to join a plan
price structure: Fixed annual fee paid in full; non-refundable
additional informations: 2021-2022 cycle: apply from 2021-05-01 and complete services by 2022-04-30; registration takes about 14-15 working days; late-cancel/no-show rules apply (24-hour notice
